subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Opposite contact-point chord passes through an isosceles base midpoint
units.statement: Let A=(0,h), B=(−b,0), C=(b,0), and draw a circle centered at A with radius r<AB. Choose one tangent point P from B and one Q from C so that PQ meets BC at M. The matching contact points are reflections across the altitude and give a chord parallel to BC; the crossing pairs use the two distinct contact-point heights. Their line crosses BC at x=0, so M is the midpoint of BC. If AB=L and AH=h, then BM=√(L²−h²).
steps: Use symmetry to pair the tangent points from B and C
Compare the two contact-point heights and show a crossing pair meets the base at its midpoint
Use the right triangle ABH to compute the half-base length
